opening.argument: The presentation promotes buying and holding Terra Luna through a signup-linked reward, while describing that reward as a way to enter the token with “zero risk exposure.” It tells viewers that buying is the easiest way to obtain a new airdrop and identifies specific holding dates tied to the snapshot. It also frames anticipated volatility and a possible price increase around May 27th as opportunities, while directly saying it is “not too late” to buy. Although the speaker acknowledges volatility, possible losses, and changing snapshot timing, those qualifications do not remove the promotional call to purchase or the suggestion that a free Bitcoin bonus can provide riskless exposure.
